cells: all 24 existing affineCostCases, unchanged seed, fixtures, prices and billing
strategy: existing createRawFixedThresholdStrategy; each run sees only its current request
controls: rerun fixed60 and incumbent; reproduce complete frozen ledgers exactly
selection: after executing all policies, choose lowest-cost eligible threshold per cell; break exact ties toward smaller threshold
eligibility: no overflow, no out-of-window ordinary/summary/prewarm input; invalid runs retained with reason, never selected
billing: ordinary input/output, all successful/failed summaries, prefix rebuilding and explicit prewarm
metrics: per-cell full fee components, grid minimum, incumbent and fixed60 gaps; per-profile main means; boundary optima flagged
transfer: for main cells only, take threshold selected at the other length for same price/fixture and apply its already executed bill; dependent same-seed prefix diagnostic, not an independent heldout result
limits: best fixed threshold in this discrete raw-policy grid only, not a global optimum or lower bound; hindsight selectors are evaluator-only and never feed the online algorithm; raw baselines have no cooldown/reclaim/quality guards
promotion: no SDK, Pi, learner, default or paid test changes
